subject.title: [Feishu] 飞书群多机器人身份混乱问题

question: Should Feishu group sessions become account/app-scoped, and what migration or compatibility contract should existing Feishu group sessions use?
rationale: The source-level failure mode is clear, but the fix changes durable identity for a security-sensitive channel path and can affect existing sessions, so automation should not choose the permanent key shape or migration behavior alone.

options.title: Account-scope Feishu group sessions
options.body: Make Feishu group conversation identity include a stable account or app component and ship the matching migration, docs, tests, and live upgrade proof.

options.title: Keep shared group sessions
options.body: Document that same-agent multi-account Feishu bots in one group share group context unless users route them to distinct agents or another explicit isolation mode.

options.title: Add opt-in isolation first
options.body: Preserve current default keys and add a narrow Feishu-owned account-scoped group isolation mode while maintainers gather upgrade proof for a future default change.

recommendation.title: Account-scope Feishu group sessions
recommendation.body: Make Feishu group conversation identity include a stable account or app component and ship the matching migration, docs, tests, and live upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is Feishu-specific and the package metadata names this handle as the community ownership signal for the plugin.
